svg.title: Boiling-water nuclear concept — Direct vessel steam & recirculation
svg.desc: Direct vessel steam & recirculation. 4 equipment references and 3 declared directed connections. Static illustrative symbols; arrows do not show instantaneous flow. This selected view does not include every plant connection.
